title: Delta Rule forward, four stages
formula: o[c] = q[c] @ S + tril(q[c] @ k[c]^T) @ v_new[c] with v_new[c] = u[c] - w[c] @ S and S <- S + k[c]^T @ v_new[c], where (w, u) = (I + (k k^T * beta) tril_strict)^-1 applied to (k*beta, v*beta); ungated, L=64 chunk, D=128, BF16 tensors and state with FP32 beta, zero initial state
study_for: A four-launch pipeline as one demo. main.py's `execute` is the whole composition: preprocess -> triangular inverse -> recompute W/U -> fused chunk recurrence, with every destination allocated NaN-poisoned by the caller and handed to OpExec with `seed_outputs=True`. The one destination that is real zeros rather than poison is the initial state, because the first chunk reads it before anything writes it.

`--stages` is not just extra printing: it swaps `recurrence_saved_kernel` in for `sub2_kernel`, because that is the variant which publishes the state and v_new histories, and it launches the standalone `sub1_kernel` score leaf that the production recurrence fuses rather than launching. Without that leaf the fused causal-mask epilogue is only ever checked against itself.

One stage, three source kernels. `INVERSE_KERNELS` holds the block inverse and the two Neumann variants, and a case exercises each. The Neumann cases are the only ones whose residual against the fp32 reference is not exactly zero under the simulator (about 2e-3 relative L2, 4.9e-4 on `wu_attn_bf16`), which is what bf16 cube operands and bf16 intermediate publishes cost in an inverse.

`attn_causal_keep_vf` and `score_causal_keep_vf` are the same body under two names: the standalone leaf's and the fused recurrence's. They are deliberately not shared, so that editing the fused path cannot quietly edit the leaf the fused path is measured against.
do_not_copy_when: You want the gated variant. This is the ungated delta rule: it is gdn_fwd evaluated at g == 0, so every exp(g_cumsum) factor is 1 and the intra-chunk decay mask is a constant causal keep. Read gdn_fwd if you need the gate.
Your chunk length is not 64 or your head dimension is not 128. There is no L or D tail path here at all; an incomplete B*H*C core assignment is handled by bounded loops, but a partial tile is not.
You need a trainable or otherwise nonzero initial state. Only the zero-initial-state path exists, and the production backward has no initial-state gradient to pair with one.

You are carrying this preprocess precision into a backward fixture. This forward applies beta after `key @ key.T` in fp32 (`delta-forward-post-mm-beta/1`); delta_rule_bwd's saved-state fixture rounds `key*beta` into a bf16 cube operand before that matmul. The two are not interchangeable and swapping them moves the third digit.
